title: OneDrive synced folder
whyItMatters: OneDrive mirrors personal and work files onto the Mac. The local copies remain after sign-out and can include whole Desktop and Documents trees.
source: macOS File Provider sync roots under ~/Library/CloudStorage - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/cloud-storage-clients
notes: Newer macOS 12.3+ location (OneDrive-Personal, OneDrive-<Org>). Older ~/OneDrive installs are not matched. Placeholders are counted, never hydrated.
